text: Attempt 18: attempt 17's schedule (the best so far) plus more income: finance ordinances from ~10,000, homes 7% from ~15,000, a second seaport at ~20,000.
Attempt 17 peaked at 29,090, the best since attempt 2 and the fastest start of all. Attempt 18 replays it and adds the income it left unused (ordinances, a higher home tax once the city is big).
